title: Playground
p: This page is yours to experiment with. Each exercise takes only a moment. Delete the results when you are done, or keep them as notes. ⌘ Z undoes your last step.
Type these examples on the empty lines below and watch them change:

ol.li: ## My heading — the space after the hashes creates a heading.
- First item — press Enter for another item, then Tab to nest it.
[] Buy milk — press ⌘ Enter to check it off.
This is **important** — the closing stars apply bold.
--- — the third dash creates a divider.

p: On an empty line, type / and insert a callout, a 3 × 3 table and a countdown. Try filtering with /callout, /table and /countdown.
Hover to the left of a line, open its block menu and change its type. Then drag its handle to move it.
Turn this paragraph into a level-two heading.
Turn this paragraph into a callout.
Drag this paragraph above the other two.
Select a few words in this paragraph. Make them bold, change their color and add a highlight. Select different words and press ⌘ ⌥ H to apply the same colors again.
Type @ below and choose a guide. Follow the link, scroll to that guide's reference area, and look for this Playground page in its backlinks.

callout.p: Finished? You now know the core editing tools. Keep this page as a scratchpad, or delete it from the sidebar when you no longer need it.
